faq.title: Everything you need to know about the marketplace.
faq.q1: Does Raketna charge commissions or handle checkout?
faq.a1: No. Raketna is a free connection bridge. Buyers and sellers arrange inspection, payment, and pickup directly with one another in EGP.
faq.q2: Can I swap a racket instead of selling it?
faq.a2: Yes. Racket listings support sale, swap, or both, allowing you to specify the exact model or weight class you are looking to trade for. Padel balls are sale-only.
faq.q3: Do I need an account just to browse or message a seller?
faq.a3: No account is needed to browse or contact a seller on WhatsApp. Sign in to create your profile and post listings.
faq.q4: Are the listings on this page available to buy right now?
faq.a4: Not yet. The items shown here are clearly labeled demo fixtures and AI-generated illustrations created to preview the marketplace experience.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How Raketna collects, uses, protects, and removes your data during our Egypt padel equipment pilot.

collect.heading: 1. Data we collect
collect.body: Visitors can browse approved listings and public seller profiles without creating an account. When you register, we store your email address and secure authentication credentials. If you create a seller profile, you choose your username, display name, account type (Personal or Business), governorate, and optional district, bio, favorite racket, and WhatsApp number. All profiles default to private until you opt in.

photos.heading: 2. Listing photos and EXIF removal
photos.body: Photos you upload for equipment listings are re-encoded to WebP with camera and GPS location metadata (EXIF) stripped automatically. All photos are stored in private storage and delivered through authorization checks: draft, pending, and rejected photos remain accessible only to you and authorized reviewers during manual moderation, and become publicly viewable only while attached to an eligible approved listing.

contact.heading: 3. WhatsApp contact and consent
contact.body: Your WhatsApp number is stored privately and never printed as plain text on public pages. It is used to create a direct WhatsApp redirect only when you explicitly turn on WhatsApp contact consent, your profile is public and active, and your listing is active. Turning off consent or hiding your profile immediately stops WhatsApp inquiries.

analytics.heading: 4. Approximate counts and cookies
analytics.body: Raketna uses essential cookies only for signed-in sessions, theme preference, and language selection. We do not use advertising trackers or cross-site tracking cookies. Listing views and admin-only WhatsApp click totals are aggregated into daily 30-day counts without storing visitor IP addresses, personal identifiers, or raw browsing histories.

providers.heading: 5. Infrastructure providers
providers.body: We do not sell personal data. Core database, authentication, and private media storage run on Supabase (EU Frankfurt region), transactional account emails (confirmation and password recovery) are delivered via Resend when custom SMTP is active, and the web application runs on our production Node/web host.

retention.heading: 6. Data retention and moderation logs
retention.body: Listings do not expire automatically and saved photos are never deleted automatically on a timer. If you edit or withdraw a listing, or if moderation removes a listing or hides/suspends a profile, public access stops immediately while records remain stored until you or an operator delete them. Non-personal moderation audit records and safety reports may be retained as needed to prevent abuse.

deletion.heading: 7. Account deletion
deletion.body: You can request deletion of your account at any time from My profile while signed in. Submitting a deletion request immediately takes any public storefront, QR link, listings, and WhatsApp contact offline. An operator then permanently removes your authentication account, profile, WhatsApp number, listings, and stored photos within 7 days.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.subtitle: Clear rules for browsing, listing, and coordinating padel equipment trades on Raketna.

role.heading: 1. Connection bridge only
role.body: Raketna is a free classified marketplace connecting padel players and sellers in Egypt to buy, sell, or swap padel rackets, balls, shoes, and bags. Raketna does not process payments, hold escrow, ship or deliver equipment, guarantee authenticity, or act as a party to any transaction. Buyers and sellers arrange inspection, payment, and meetup directly on WhatsApp at their own discretion.

accounts.heading: 2. Accounts and seller classification
accounts.body: You must provide a valid email address and keep your credentials secure. Usernames are fixed after profile creation. Choosing a Business account type reflects higher listing capacity only—it does not mean Raketna has verified the seller’s identity, authenticity, or legal business registration.

listings.heading: 3. Listing accuracy and disclosures
listings.body: Sellers must list only genuine padel equipment they own or are authorized to sell, upload 3 to 4 honest photos of the actual item, state prices clearly in EGP (whole-offer price for balls), disclose wear accurately, and explicitly declare any racket frame cracks or carbon repairs. Listings for shoes, balls, and bags are sale-only; rackets may be listed for sale, swap, or both.

moderation.heading: 4. Manual listing review
moderation.body: Every new listing and every edited published listing requires manual moderator approval before appearing publicly. Approval checks completeness and basic marketplace guidelines only; it is not an inspection, warranty, or authenticity certification. Raketna may reject, remove, or request corrections on any listing and may hide or suspend accounts that violate these terms.

conduct.heading: 5. Prohibited items and abuse
conduct.body: Counterfeit equipment, misleading photos, non-padel items, spam, duplicate flooding, harassment, scraping, or attempts to bypass listing limits or access private media are prohibited. Signed-in users may report suspicious listings or profiles for moderator review.

liability.heading: 6. Inspection and responsibility
liability.body: Always inspect equipment in person—especially racket frames, faces, and grip integrity—before handing over cash or completing a swap. To the fullest extent permitted by law, Raketna is provided on an as-is pilot basis without warranties regarding listings, seller conduct, or completed deals.

termination.heading: 7. Closing your account and updates
termination.body: You may withdraw listings, disable public visibility, or submit an authenticated account deletion request from My profile at any time. We may update these terms as Raketna moves beyond the controlled pilot, with the effective date updated on this page.
